sentences.text: I.A.No.1/2024 has been filed for condonation of a delay of 1265 days i.e., 3 years and 4 months.
The petitioner/claimant in his affidavit has stated that he sustained multiple injuries and became permanently disabled.
Due to this condition, he could not contact his counsel in time.

He further stated that he recently contacted his counsel and therefore,
the delay has occurred.
2. In the counter filed by the respondent/BMTC, the Assistant Law Officer of the BMTC Central Office has stated that MVC No.6915/2017 was disposed of on 22.11.2018.
It is further stated that BMTC had filed MFA No.2068/2019 challenging the said award, in which the present appellant was NC: 2026:KHC:13883 HC-KAR represented by his advocate.
The said appeal was dismissed as withdrawn on 26.08.2022.
A copy of the memo of withdrawal has been produced.
3. It is contended that the petitioner has now filed the present appeal two years after the withdrawal of the said MFA, without any explanation for the inordinate delay.
It is also stated that the petitioner has not produced any medical records in support of his claim.
The delay is inordinate and thus, the respondent is requested for dismissal of the application.
4. The petitioner/injured claimant has filed the present appeal for enhancement of compensation with an abnormal delay of 1265 days.
The reason stated by him is that he could not contact his advocate as he had become permanently disabled.
The reason assigned for such an inordinate delay is neither convincing nor satisfactory.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent has also submitted that in the meanwhile, they had filed an appeal in which the petitioner had entered appearance through his advocate.
This clearly indicates that the present appeal has NC: 2026:KHC:13883 HC-KAR been filed as an afterthought, after the disposal of MFA No.2068/2019 filed by the Managing Director of BMTC.
Therefore, this Court finds no merit in I.A.No.1/2024 and accordingly, the same is dismissed.

In view of the dismissal of Rohith M vs The Managing Director on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39812244/
2 I.A.No.1/2024, MFA No.5107/2024 also stands dismissed.
